issues.title: Secure storage writes fail on a locally signed macOS build

criteria.requirement: One shared factory defines how this app reaches the platform keychain, and every secure-storage call site uses it.

tests.name: every secure-storage call site goes through the shared factory

criteria.requirement: The macOS option is the classic login keychain, which needs no keychain-access-groups entitlement.

tests.name: the shared store avoids the data-protection keychain

criteria.requirement: A test asserts the constructed options, so the platform configuration cannot silently regress.
criteria.reason: Evidence ownership was pruned to one criterion per named test; this criterion must gain its own uniquely-owned named suite.

criteria.requirement: dart format lib test, flutter analyze, and flutter test are clean.
criteria.reason: The required CI lanes run on the PR; a local toolchain below the pinned Dart SDK cannot resolve dependencies to reproduce the gate.
